budget.reason: ref_tile: boundary budget 0.2 T applied in-run

structural_change: IDX-SCORE leaf (H-NETLIST/IDX-SCORE 2026-10-17): one chunk of ot_hbm_idx_score_static as an identical leaf of the 4x4 scorer cluster. Retimed core ot_hbm_idx_chunk_rt (cycle-exact vs the 32-hslice systolic chunk; 590k -> 215k flops measured, 0.166 mm2 std) + registered W->E forward (W pin reg, E pin reg) + 4-slot sum bus. 17 clock roots: clk (pin/glue regs) + clk_pair[0..15] (head-pair regions, ~13.4k sinks each); roots meet only at register-to-register seams (results/arch/hbm_idx_score_rt_1017/README.md). TW4-IDXSCORE 10-19: (1) rst9 gate synth 14,798 s > 14,400 cap (SHARE 6,590 s + ABC 3,250 s over ~288 flattened q4dot/faddl/bmul copies): keep_hierarchy on those instances in ot_hbm_idx_chunk_rt (synthesised once per definition; attribute only). (2) W/E pins re-kitted to the shared leaf face table (pin_ranges, qw E / qe W use the same ranges) with route.pin_balance so abutted buses meet bit for bit.
